{{Top|leg}}
The '''contoured grip''' was an enhanced [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] for bladed weapons that was shorter than the average hilt, thereby allowing for maximum accuracy. Nonetheless, the reduced leverage limited the weapon's power and potential for debilitating injuries. This grip had been available in two versions, advanced and superior.
